notes.title: Big update! Bagua Palm 64 hands finally welcome free download!
notes.content:
Dear users,
After two years, the "Chinese traditional martial art Bagua Palm 64 hands" finally welcomed a big version update, we have received friends' suggestions before, and targeted optimization and modification of the software, thank you very much for your attention and love for China's intangible cultural heritage "Bagua Palm"!

[b] This big update includes: [/b]
1. Updated to the traditional Chinese style ink painting scene, and optimized the character art;
2. Added the introduction of basic teaching of eye, palm, fist, body, leg and step;
3. Added the set description function of the move drill (including dubbing);
4. Pause to view the hand close-up, and add the teaching video of teacher Gao Jiwu's personal teaching of the use of moves;
5. Introduction of main characters was added.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41721125/1bfce32dc172d970d6d39498a98ffda29ff1810a.jpg[/img]

Most importantly, in order to promote the popularization of traditional Chinese martial arts culture, [u] "Bagua Palm 64 hands" finally ushered in a free download! [/u] New users can practice and experience all the functions of the first 8 hands of Baguazhang. Since this software was developed by the team without any funding, the last 56 hand drills and set instructions need to be upgraded to vip users to view, and please understand the martial arts lovers. All revenue generated from the sale of the software will also be invested in the subsequent optimization of the software. Of course, [u] old users who have purchased the "Baguazhang 64 hands" software will not have to pay to enjoy all the features included in this update. [/u]

Baguazhang classic 64 form is divided into eight, each form of eight, implicating the 64 hexagrams of Yi Li. Its content is rich, the movement is changeable, can be single operation or practice, attack and defense outstanding, strong skills. But only by practicing the palm first, after the palm is perfected, and then practicing the 64 style, can we get its gist.

The images and movements in the software are performed and captured by Mr. Gao Jiwu, a famous contemporary martial artist (Chinese Martial arts Eight Dan) and the fifth generation of Baguazhang, and produced by his apprentice Fan Weipeng into a teaching application for inheriting and promoting traditional martial arts, which is convenient for the public to practice.

If you have any comments or suggestions on this update, please leave a message or go to QQ group 983047433 to communicate, thank you for your support!

At the same time, please follow the social accounts of the software producers to follow the latest developments of their software development:
Wechat public account: 彩蛋实验室
Bilibili: 后海清晨跑跑步
Sina Weibo: 传统武术-百家拳
 
Science and technology enable traditional culture, innovation and reproduction of centuries of intangible heritage!
Grandmaster, who is not me!

Bagua Palm 64 hands software development team all members
November 2024
